chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated from Abbas al-Naqid, who said:

What I had in my possession became dispersed, and my customers drifted away from me. So I complained about that to Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, and he said to me: “Combine the two prayers, al-Zuhr and al-'Asr, and you will see what you like.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: How does combining al-Zuhr and al-'Asr relate to relief in livelihood according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a man complaining to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام about the loss of his assets and customers. The Imam عليه السلام instructs him to combine al-Zuhr and al-'Asr, indicating a practical devotional act connected to relief and improvement in livelihood.
